units.source_text: 古歌：“更科姨舍山，月色太凄清。

en.t: An old poem says: On Mount Obasute in Sarashina, the moonlight is unbearably bleak.

units.source_text: 望月增忧思，不能慰我情。”

en.t: Gazing at the full moon only deepens my sorrow; it cannot comfort my heart.
It appears in the Kokin Wakashu.

units.source_text: 姨舍山在信浓国更科郡。

en.t: Mount Obasute is in Sarashina District of Shinano Province.
